meta.project: The Flying Bus: Interactive News Platform for Kids

product_overview: The Flying Bus is an innovative interactive news platform tailored for children aged 8-16, integrating traditional journalism with modern Web3 technology and gamification to create a safe, engaging, and educational environment where young readers can consume and create age-appropriate news content while earning cryptocurrency rewards.
core_goals: Provide a safe and engaging news platform for children focusing on age-appropriate content.
Empower young readers and journalists with tools for content creation, collaboration, and interaction.
Integrate Web3 technology for crypto wallet connection and token-based rewards to incentivize engagement.
Enable comprehensive content moderation and safety measures ensuring child-appropriate and secure user experience.
Foster community through social features including comments, voting, profiles, and leaderboards.
Deliver high performance, scalability, and secure architecture compliant with privacy regulations (COPPA, GDPR).
key_features: Multi-type Article Management System with rich text editing, video support, debates, and storyboard episodic content.
Robust User Management with invitation-based author registration, various authentication methods (email, social, Web3 wallet), and role-based permissions.
Web3 Integration featuring Thirdweb SDK for wallet support on Polygon Mumbai testnet and ERC-20 token reward mechanisms.
Comprehensive Comment System with threaded comments, likes, moderation, and community flagging capabilities.
Interactive Debate Voting System with real-time result visualization.
Advanced Content Moderation Tools including automated screening, human review workflows, and reporting systems.
Achievements and Gamification elements such as badges, reading streaks, and leaderboards to encourage participation.
Performance Monitoring and Analytics providing content, user engagement, and platform-wide metrics.
Media Management including file uploads, image optimization, and CDN integration.
Secure and validated user input handling with React Hook Form and Zod.
Email integration using Resend API for notifications and invitation management.
user_flow_summary: Reader Journey: Discover categorized news content, read articles optimized for kids, engage via comments and voting, earn tokens and achievements, and view personal reading analytics via profile.
Author Journey: Invitation-based onboarding, article creation with rich text and media, submission through review workflow, publication, and community feedback.
Moderator Journey: Access moderation queue, review and approve content and comments, manage flagged reports, and review moderation analytics.
User Wallet Integration: Connect crypto wallet optionally post-authentication, view token balances, and earn cryptocurrency rewards from activities.
Admin Workflow: Manage users, content, categories, and moderation tasks through admin portal dashboards with analytics and audit logging capabilities.
validation_criteria: All authentication methods including invitation, email/password, social login, and Web3 wallet must function securely and seamlessly.
Article creation supports all formats with full editing capabilities, draft saving, and version tracking.
Token reward system accurately calculates and dispenses tokens on designated user engagement events.
Comment system supports threading, moderation, likes, and community flagging with appropriate permission enforcement.
Moderation workflows effectively filter inappropriate content and enable human review before publication.
Analytics dashboards reflect accurate real-time data for content performance, user engagement, and platform health.
Media uploads process correctly with image optimization and CDN delivery within performance targets.
Form validations consistently enforce schema rules using Zod and gracefully handle errors.
Security measures including input sanitization, XSS protection, and privacy settings are fully implemented and tested.
Platform maintains required performance benchmarks: fast page loads, low error rates, and scalability targets under load.
All features comply with COPPA, GDPR, and other relevant privacy and legal standards.
Web3 smart contract interactions for token rewards are secure and successful at a 99%+ transaction rate.

features.name: Authentication System
features.description: Email and password authentication system with invitation-based author registration and auto-login flows. Secure user account management for the platform.

features.name: Article Management System
features.description: Comprehensive content management with rich text editing, multiple article types (standard, debate, video, storyboard), draft system, and publishing workflow.

features.name: Web3 Integration & Rewards
features.description: Optional crypto wallet connection for authenticated users using Thirdweb SDK. Token reward system on Polygon Mumbai testnet for user engagement rewards tied to Flying Bus accounts.

features.name: Comment System
features.description: Threaded comment system with moderation, likes, replies, and community-driven content flagging.

features.name: Debate Voting System
features.description: Interactive voting system for debate articles with real-time results and user engagement tracking.

features.name: Admin Portal
features.description: Comprehensive administrative interface for content management, user management, analytics, and moderation tools.

features.name: Category System
features.description: Content categorization with filtering, pagination, and category-specific layouts for Headliners, Debates, Learning, Neighborhood, School News, Spice It Up, and Storyboard.

features.name: User Profile System
features.description: User profiles with activity tracking, achievements, reading statistics, and privacy settings.

features.name: Storyboard System
features.description: Episodic content management for serialized stories with series navigation and episode tracking.

features.name: Content Moderation
features.description: Multi-layer content moderation with approval workflows, flagging system, and safety features for child-appropriate content.

features.name: Media Management
features.description: File upload, image optimization, and media asset management with CDN integration.

features.name: Navigation System
features.description: Responsive navigation with mobile menu, breadcrumbs, and category filtering.

features.name: Error Handling & Recovery
features.description: Comprehensive error boundary system with graceful error recovery and user-friendly error messages.

features.name: Performance Monitoring
features.description: Performance tracking, optimization, and monitoring with analytics and metrics collection.

features.name: Email System
features.description: Server-side email system using Resend API via Supabase Edge Functions for invitation management and notifications.

features.name: Video Integration
features.description: YouTube video integration with metadata extraction and video article support.

features.name: Form Validation
features.description: Comprehensive form validation using React Hook Form with Zod schemas for type-safe validation.

features.name: Security & Sanitization
features.description: Input sanitization, XSS protection, and security measures for child-safe content.

features.name: Analytics & Metrics
features.description: User engagement tracking, content analytics, and dashboard metrics for administrators.

features.name: Testing Infrastructure
features.description: Comprehensive testing setup with unit tests, integration tests, and test utilities.
